prompt: From slightly above, a 35mm lens, a cramped tailor's back room at night in the 1920s. A thin Jewish tailor of about 55, long narrow clean-shaven face, deep-set eyes, grey temples, small dark skullcap, waistcoat, a cloth tape draped round his neck and hanging down his chest, looks up three-quarter at us and sings with weary ease, hands flat on a cutting table. Well behind him and small, two men in bandanas and flat caps scoop coins from an open brass till, a revolver pointed at the floor. A mustard-yellow shaded bulb lights his face; crimson curtain cloth glows in the dark behind. No lettering on anything. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
